questions.question: **Identify how will you say that "The doctor treated the victims of the violence very carefully", in the passive voice.**

options.text: The doctor was very careful while providing treatment to the victims
The doctor's care was shown to the victims of the violence
The victims of the violence were treated very carefully by the doctor
The victims were treated attentively by the doctor

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **The victims of the violence were treated very carefully by the doctor.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the passive voice as the subject (**the victims of the violence**) is receiving the action of the verb (**treated**), instead of performing it.
 
• The sentence follows the passive voice structure: **Object + auxiliary verb (were) + past participle of main verb (treated) + by + subject (the doctor).__**
 
• The sentence emphasizes the action of treating the victims carefully, rather than the doctor's care itself.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

questions.question:
Choose the option that is the correct passive form of the sentence.

Ravi gave you the information?

options.text: Was the information given to you by Ravi?
Have the information been given to you?
Has the information given to you?
You have been given the information?

questions.solution:
The correct passive form of the sentence is option **1) "Was the information given to you by Ravi?**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the active sentence "Ravi gave you the information," the subject "Ravi" performs the action on the object "you" and "the information."
 
• In the passive form, the object becomes the subject of the sentence, and the subject becomes the object.
 
• Here's an explanation of how the active sentence "Ravi gave you the information" is transformed into the passive form "Was the information given to you by Ravi?" using the rules for converting from active to passive voice:
 
• Identify the subject, verb, and object:
 
 
• Subject: Ravi
 
• Verb: gave
 
• Object: the information
 
 
 
• Move the object to the beginning of the sentence and make it the subject of the passive sentence:
 
 
• The information
 
 
 
• Use the appropriate form of the verb "be" (in this case, "was") followed by the past participle of the main verb (in this case, "given"):
 
 
• Was given
 
 
 
• Include the preposition "by" followed by the agent (the person or thing performing the action):
 
 
• By Ravi
 
 
 
• If there is an indirect object in the active sentence (in this case, "you"), include it after the preposition "to":
 
 
• To you
 
 
 
• Putting it all together, we get the passive form: "**Was the information given to you by Ravi?**"
 
 
• This passive sentence correctly conveys that the information was given by Ravi to you.

This creativity will be overlooked by me.
This creativity will being overlooked by me.

questions.solution:

• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "I will never overlook this creativity."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "this creativity" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will never overlook" to "will never be overlooked" (future simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "me."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

questions.question:

options.text: Let the wheels take you.
Let you take the wheels.
Let the wheels be taken by you.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**Let the wheels be taken by you.**"

• **In this case, "wheels" is the object of the active sentence "Take the wheels." Therefore, it becomes the subject of the passive sentence.**
 
• **"Be taken" is the passive form of "take."**
 
• "By you" is added to indicate who is doing the action (in this case, taking the wheels).
 
• Thus, the given sentence in passive form will be:
 
 
• Let the wheels be taken by you.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "Let the wheels take you," is in active voice and does not match the given sentence in passive voice.
 
• Option 2, "Let you take the wheels," is in active voice and has the subject and object reversed from the original sentence.
 
• Option 4, "Let wheels you take," is not grammatically correct.
